name: SD WebUI Forge
overview: A highly optimized fork of Automatic1111 that drastically reduces VRAM overhead and increases generation speeds.
details: Forge uses a custom backend architecture to optimize VRAM management, allowing users to run complex SDXL and FLUX workloads on GPUs with as little as 8GB of VRAM.
For OpenClaw, it provides an alternative API endpoint for users who prefer the traditional WebUI payload structure over ComfyUI's complex node-graph JSON arrays.
